geometry.height_status: Purdue Emergency Plan revised 2026-10-16 identifies west A as 8 floors and middle B/east C as 6. The model uses 3.3 m floor-to-floor, B/C roof 19.8 m and west-A roof 26.4 m; these heights are estimates, not surveyed elevations.
geometry.orientation_status: Footprint follows official GIS ring. Glass stairwell location is a qualitative estimate because the available photograph is not compass-tagged.

model_changes: Rebuilt the structural shell from official Purdue GIS FID 410 and retained campus coordinates; source-to-shell axis bound delta is 0.000022 m in the project local approximation.
Modeled Purdue BEP section counts: west A eight floors, middle B and east C six floors, with a B-section basement. Floor-to-floor and roof heights remain estimates.

Added narrow repeated window bays, dark red-brown procedural brick, unequal west/east multi-story glazing, a pale first-floor canopy with columns, ground-floor glass, two east retail storefront panels/signs, and roof mechanical screens. The photo supports broad visual features; exact façade dimensions remain estimated.

Added floor plates, central corridor strips, typical-size schematic room modules, room partitions, double beds, desks and lounge cues across the modeled levels. Layout is schematic and is not presented as a measured floor plan.
Added two-sided exterior renders and an isolated level-3 plan render for review.

validation.structural_shell_meshes: Fresh-open QA: base shell, west-A extension, B/C roof, west-A roof and basement all have zero boundary and nonmanifold edges.

remaining_uncertainty: No dimensioned elevations or survey height; 3.3 m floor-to-floor and total height values are estimates.

Interior room modules use Purdue Residences typical-room dimensions, but the actual building-wide arrangement has not been confirmed from dimensioned plans.

Independent review flagged wedge-like forms on the west end in the reverse preview as unverified; only one exterior photo is available, so this facade detail needs a confirming source or later correction.
